scene_analysis.scene_overview: A street view of a city street with tall buildings on both sides, featuring a white car parked on the left side of the street and a scooter parked next to it. The street has a tree growing out of the sidewalk and a trash bin on the left side. There are several cars parked along the street and a few pedestrians walking around. The sky is overcast.
scene_analysis.buildings: The buildings have a mix of concrete and brick facades, with balconies and windows. Some of the buildings have awnings or shutters.
scene_analysis.materials: The ground is paved with asphalt, and there are several large planters with trees and bushes along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and trash cans along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.vegetation: There are several trees and bushes along the sidewalk, as well as some potted plants.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs posted on the buildings, including a stop sign and a directional sign.
scene_analysis.pedestrian_activity: There are several people walking along the sidewalk, but they are not densely packed.
scene_analysis.as_resident: The area appears to be residential, with several apartments and shops visible.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: The area is quiet and peaceful, with a few tourists taking photos.
scene_analysis.as_student: The area is lively, with several students walking around.
